newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fudao aims to issue up to one bln fund units.
newsitem.headline: Fudao aims to issue up to one bln fund units.

text.p: Hainan-based Fudao Fund said on Monday it would apply to the People's Bank of China for permission to issue up to one billion fund units by 2012.

The 20-year closed-end fund, which has 160 million fund units listed on the Shenzhen bourse, was established in 1992, a spokesman for the fund told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
The central bank had previously approved an increase in its listed fund units to 200 million, he said.
Fudao will file an application for the expansion plan with the central bank in the near future, he added.
Fudao said in a notice published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times that its fund beneficiaries had approved the plan at a meeting in Haikou, capital of Hainan province, over the weekend.
Fudao, managed by Hainan Province Securities Co, said in an interim report that its first-half net earnings for 1996 were 43.02 million yuan, up from 4.32 million in the same period of last year.
Fudao said its operations in the first half were strongly boosted by bullishness in China's equities market.
